verdict.rationale: Apify's first-party docs describe Apify Proxy, which avoids blocking by rotating datacenter and residential IPs. The SDK documents proxy management with Apify Proxy, custom or third-party proxies, and a SessionPool class that rotates proxy IPs along with cookies. Missing for 10: in-depth configuration details (e.g., rotation policies, geo-targeting) and independent or hands-on corroboration of block-avoidance effectiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks

citations.quote: Avoid blocking by smartly rotating datacenter and residential IP addresses.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
you can use your own proxy servers, proxy servers acquired from third-party providers, or you can rely on Apify Proxy for your scraping needs.
